findings.recommendation: Change the text color of inactive breadcrumb elements to a darker gray (such as #595959 or darker) to guarantee a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the light background.
Apply 'list-style: none' to remove the default bullets, and instead use clean horizontal padding or custom SVG markers to create comfortable breathing room between the list items and indicators.

Allow the title text to wrap to a maximum of two lines. Implement a fixed minimum height on the title container to prevent any vertical misalignment of the prices and 'Add to basket' buttons below them.
